response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS n FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS avg_n FROM c) SELECT SUM(c.n) AS total_films, AVG(c.n - a.avg_n) AS avg_excess FROM c CROSS JOIN a WHERE c.n > a.avg_n

assumptions.assumption: The average is taken over ratings that have at least one film with inventory (ratings with zero such films would not appear; all 5 ratings are well populated so this is expected to make no difference).
'Average amount by which their counts exceed the across-rating average' is the mean of (count - average) over the above-average ratings only.
